title: Calculate Epigenetic Clocks
text: example simulates data carries two kinds missing data: CpGs absent altogether, CpGs present missing samples. two kinds missingness handled differently. CpG absent altogether either filled reference value ships clock, dropped. CpG present missing samples column mean imputed (.e., CpG-wise). clocks need Female covariate. readily available, predict_sex() scores two clocks DNAmSex_Wang group returns predicted sex every sample. pheno provides Female, predict_sex() also returns recorded_sex sex_mismatch, reports many samples disagree. Clock calculation performed calc_clocks() function. calc_clocks() can also run batches combined afterwards. .data.frame() .matrix() finalizes scores analysis. .data.frame() returns long wide.
code: set.seed(1) sim <- sim_DNAm(   c("Horvath1", "Bohlin96"),   n = 6,   Age = TRUE,   remove = 10 # drop CpGs entirely, to simulate completely missing CpGs )  # simulate partially missing CpGs sim[["DNAm"]][sample.int(length(sim[["DNAm"]]), 20)] <- NA  # count partial NAs sum(is.na(sim[["DNAm"]])) #> [1] 20 # The betas are random here, so the mismatches are expected. sex_sim <- sim_DNAm("DNAmSex_Wang", n = 6, Female = TRUE)  predict_sex(sex_sim[["DNAm"]], sex_sim[["pheno"]])[1:3, ] #        ID DNAmSex_Wang_ChrX DNAmSex_Wang_ChrY predicted_sex recorded_sex sex_mismatch # 1 sample1          38.03396         -4.118079        Female         Male         TRUE # 2 sample2          36.36661         -4.152196        Female         Male         TRUE # 3 sample3          37.47450         -3.756762        Female       Female        FALSE res <- calc_clocks(   DNAm = sim[["DNAm"]],   clocks = c("Horvath1", "Bohlin96"),   pheno = sim[["pheno"]] ) batch_1 <- sim_DNAm(c("Knight"), n = 6, suffix = "1") batch_2 <- sim_DNAm(c("Knight"), n = 6, suffix = "2")  r1 <- calc_clocks(batch_1[["DNAm"]], "Knight", pheno = batch_1[["pheno"]]) r2 <- calc_clocks(batch_2[["DNAm"]], "Knight", pheno = batch_2[["pheno"]])  rbind(r1, r2) # long, the default head(as.data.frame(res), n = 3) #>        ID clock_id       score #> 1 sample1 Horvath1   0.1544864 #> 2 sample2 Horvath1  72.9475426 #> 3 sample3 Horvath1 107.7384507 # wide head(as.data.frame(res, long = FALSE), n = 3) #>        ID    Horvath1 Bohlin96 #> 1 sample1   0.1544864 187.9799 #> 2 sample2  72.9475426 239.7353 #> 3 sample3 107.7384507 227.8278
